references.text: Psalm 22:1 describes a feeling of abandonment that can be seen as a parallel to Jesus' cry from the cross.
In Psalm 31:5, David commits his spirit into the Lord's hands, which resembles Jesus' final act.
Isaiah 53:12 speaks of one who pours out his life unto death, something that can be connected with Jesus' death on the cross.
Luke 23:46 describes how Jesus cried out loudly and committed his spirit, which directly corresponds to the event in Mark 15:37.
In John 19:30, when Jesus says 'It is finished' and gives up his spirit, this is a parallel event.
